$comment: Model routing for the autonomous build loop (ADR-0008). The runner health-checks providers in 'order' and uses the first that answers: OmniRoute is forced unless it is unavailable, then Morph direct, then DeepInfra. 'harness' picks the agent program for that provider: 'codex' (BYOK, OS sandbox; OmniRoute only - Codex no longer supports the chat API format so it cannot reach Morph/DeepInfra) or 'opencode'. Each agent declares a model_class; 'classes' maps it to a model on that provider. keyEnv must be one of the provider keys the runner allows. Tuned by tech-scout; no governance approval needed for model names. Pinned model ids are used instead of OmniRoute 'combos' because a combo can switch the underlying model mid-session, which breaks Codex's pinned turn and provider prompt caching.
